title: Preact Action (Popup)
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the toolbar icon to open the action popup
Edit src/action/ActionApp.tsx and save to see fast refresh update it
useCases: A toolbar popup rendered by Preact
Quick actions that read and open tabs with no permission
Starting point for Preact extensions with a popup

store.summary: Adds a toolbar popup to the browser with a simple Preact page.
versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the action-preact template. Not yet submitted to any store.
